1215 AM Mch 3d  City Point Mch 2d 1865
1130 PM 2d Secy of War ---- My despatch of the PM answers yours
of 930 PM this evening I do not think it possible for Lee to to
send any thing towards Washn unless it should be a Brig of cavalry
---- Augurs returns show a good force of cavalry to meet
any thing of the kind besides a large Infantry force
<deletion>twenty</deletion> The great number of deserters & refugees coming in
daily enables us to learn if any considerable force start off
almost as soon as <insertion>it</insertion> starts ---- except in the neighborhood of 
Staunton there is not now north of the Chickahominhy five thousand rebel
soldiers including all the guards on the Central Rail Road
---- I have not sent a force to the Rappahannock but shall
do so as soon as possible sig  US Grant Lt Gen
